name: Joy for All Walker Squawker
description: A small animatronic bird that magnet-mounts to a walker or rollator, chirping and singing in response to touch, sound, and motion — including a "don't forget me" reminder song when the walker is left behind. Sold individually in Cardinal or Bluebird. Invented by 93-year-old Rita Melone.

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.note: ~7.8 oz — much smaller than the Pup/Cat

specs.label: Form Factor
specs.note: magnetic perch mount, not a standalone pet

specs.label: Response
specs.note: touch, light, sound, and motion sensors

specs.label: Signature Feature
specs.note: chirps when the walker is left stationary/behind

specs.label: Movement
specs.note: synced to chirps; no body movement

specs.label: Variants
specs.note: sold separately, not as a pair

specs.label: Positioning
specs.note: companionship to encourage consistent walker use

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: battery-powered, no app or connectivity — Ageless Innovation FAQ

sourcing: Verified against Ageless Innovation's own product page and origin-story post, a 2021 Gizmodo preview, 2022 Boston Globe and ABC News/GMA profiles of inventor Rita Melone, a RehabPub feature, and retailer listings (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy). Cardinal and Bluebird are confirmed sold separately, not as a pair, despite the marketing photo showing both. Cardinal shows out-of-stock/discontinuation signals on the official site and Best Buy as of this research; Bluebird appears more reliably available. Whether this product is included in Ageless Innovation's May 2026 "750,000 adoptions" milestone could not be confirmed — that announcement does not break results down by product.

pricing.summary: $64.99 per bird direct from Ageless Innovation, and the same price at third-party retailers such as Amazon, Walmart, and Staples. Stock is uneven by color: Cardinal has shown out of stock on joyforall.com and unavailable in new condition at Best Buy, while Bluebird remains available directly.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Walker Squawker's core mechanism is a "don't forget me" behavior: motion sensors detect when the mobility walker it clips to has stopped moving, and the bird chirps a reminder to bring it along. That's a functional walker-compliance feature — a genuine differentiator from Ageless Innovation's other Companion Pet products, which offer no equivalent function.

firmwareCommunity.note: Joy for All Walker Squawker has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
